live_file_response.note: The live static file on the non-official SSSR.SU host, byte-identical to the recorded capture; requested without Accept-Encoding and served without Content-Encoding.

corroborating_responses.note: 'Законы, постановления и другие акты, принятые пятым Съездом народных депутатов СССР', the acts appended to the Congress bulletins: PDF p. 9 prints resolution 2389-I 'Об освобождении А. И. Лукьянова от обязанностей Председателя Верховного Совета СССР', 'Москва, Кремль. 4 сентября 1991 г. № 2389-I', as in Vedomosti 1991 No. 37 art. 1079; PDF p. 2 prints resolution 2381-I (2 September 1991) electing the Congress's working Presidium (the President, heads or representatives of the republics and the chamber chairmen). Read for corroboration; no claim.

provenance_note: Raw Internet Archive capture (id_ form) of https://snd.sssr.su/V/5.pdf, captured at 2024-09-01T12:51:54Z, before the 7 September 2026 cutoff; requested without an Accept-Encoding header (curl without --compressed, i.e. identity) and served without Content-Encoding, so the recorded identity is the uncompressed body as replayed (a request accepting gzip is served gzip-encoded, with different bytes). The same bytes are served as a static file by the live host (live_file_response); the capture is recorded as the identity because it is fixed before the cutoff. The original response is not checked into this repository; this checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not the original response. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.
rights_note: Attributed factual paraphrases only; no source artwork or portrait copied, and no photograph, emblem, signature image or expressive source text is republished. No open license is asserted. No portrait permission or likeness approval is established.
scope_note: The official stenographic bulletin of the Fifth Congress's sitting of 4 September 1991, a page-image scan with an OCR layer, hosted by the non-official SSSR.SU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff, byte-identical to the live static file (live_file_response). Found by the independent check of part C, as was the acts publication attached as a corroborating response. The presiding officer's summary of the Supreme Soviet's earlier decisions is not imported: those decisions have their own claims.

visual_review.method: PDF pages 1, 3 and 5-6 read from the text layer by the independent check of part C and by this packet; the presiding officer is named once, on p. 3, with no change before the vote. The acts publication was read at PDF pp. 1, 2 and 9.

rows.printed_name: А. И. Лукьянова (genitive; initials and surname only)
rows.role_title: Chairman of the USSR Supreme Soviet
rows.text: At the morning sitting of 4 September 1991 (Kremlin Palace of Congresses, 10:00, 'Председательствует Президент СССР М. С. Горбачев') the presiding officer proposes, without debate, to release 'А. И. Лукьянова от обязанностей Председателя Верховного Совета СССР'; the bulletin records 'Постановление об освобождении А. И. Лукьянова принято' and the vote: quorum 1113, for 1702, against 20, abstained 78, total 1800, not voting 44.
rows.locator: PDF p. 3 (sitting heading); PDF pp. 5-6 (the proposal, the result and the vote)
